column1: es on government debt. Balanced Budgets Versus Optimal Fiscal Policy In the United States, many state constitutions require the state government to run a balanced budget. A recurring topic of political debate is whether the U.S. Constitution should require a balanced budget for the federal government as well. Most economists oppose a strict rule requiring the government to balance its budget. There are three reasons that optimal fiscal policy may at times call for a budget deficit or surplus.
